label: s1_other_area_plaza_01_01
text: Hey, welcome to Loyalty Plaza!\c\nThis place used to be called Loyal Three Park,\nbut the name changed over time.

label: s1_other_area_plaza_03_01
text:
Over there at the back of the plaza is the Loyal
Three Monument!\c
The Loyal Three were heroic Pokémon who
helped protect our village a long time ago!

label: s1_other_area_plaza_03_02
text: Hey, the Loyal Three Monument’s all busted!\nDid Carmine finally go berserk or something?

label: s1_other_area_plaza_03_03
text: Even if the Loyal Three were bad guys, I still have\nfond memories of the Loyal Three Monument...

label: s1_other_area_plaza_03_04
text: Hey, thanks for fixing the Loyal Three Monument!\nI donated a bit of money too.
